archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with Old Money Tech elements (Trust, Authority, Clarity)

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3. Adds character without losing professional trust.

body.usage: Use for UI elements, paragraphs, descriptions.

mono.usage: Use for CSV column headers, data snippets, file names, and field mapping contexts.

grids_and_layouts.landing_hero: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero text on col-span-5, live demo on col-span-7.
grids_and_layouts.mapping_split_view: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mapping controls (left) col-span-5, Live PDF preview (right) col-span-7.

motion.interactions: Hover states must include a slight translateY (-1px) and shadow increase. Buttons scale active (scale-95).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over emerald/indigo is white. Muted text must remain >4.5:1 ratio on #FAFAF7.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-zone').

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide-react for icons. Build custom layout for Wizard steps. Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn components for UI logic (select, accordion). Use sonner for toasts.

custom.UploadZone: Dashed border (border-indigo-500/30), light indigo bg on drag-over, large Lucide Upload icon.
custom.MappingRow: Flex container connecting CSV Column (mono font) via a drawn SVG line/arrow to PDF Field.
custom.PrivacyBadge: Fixed or sticky small pill at the top/hero: '100% Local • No Server Uploads' with a lock icon.
custom.Stepper: Horizontal numbered steps. Active step gets indigo bg, completed gets emerald checkmark.

hero_background.description: Minimalist overhead desk, use as subtle blurred background or hero asset for abstract representation.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the App container.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus states, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-8, p-12).
Implement the 'Try the sample' flow which fully simulates the 3-step wizard with pre-loaded demo data.
Use generic component names and `.js` (not .tsx) if writing standalone components.
Include 'data-testid' on all actionable and informational elements.
